data.description: Scrap is what you spend at a Research Table to unlock items, and it's the usual currency at vendors. Barrels give 2, [basic crates](/world/crate-basic) 3, military crates 8 and elite crates 25. [Tech Trash](/items/tech-trash) and fuses recycle for 20 each in a Green Recycler. [Bandit Camp](/monument/bandit-camp) sells 2 scrap for 1 HQM, fishing villages pay 30 for 5 [small trout](/items/small-trout), and it's used in 11 recipes, such as Gears, Nailgun and every workbench.
data.name: Scrap
